$comment: Hand-written at adoption on 2026-11-10 (nen scaffold init had no lane to write it from). Since zheref/swift-cheatsheets#1 (2026-11-11) the site is Gatsby + TypeScript: the iteration checks are `build` (Gatsby site + offline index.html) then `lint` (tsc and scripts/verify.mts on both built pages), and `test` is the vitest suite, required. review.scopes starts from Hatsu's own rows cut down to what this repository has: code (every path), security (CI workflows, scripts, the serve scripts, the contract) and ui (the shared components, the adapters, the diagrams and the generated page). Values below marked with a $<key> sibling were written at their catalogue default by config_values.sh fill and are the repository's own once set.

pr.$sections: available sections: delivery — Always-first ledger-rendered delivery metadata; outside the seven-reader cap. | changes — Before/After for a named consumer; Case for/Case against; what would flip the decision. | why — Source/What it showed/Why it matters now, followed by the authoring nature. | how — Mermaid structure diagram and Item/Kind/Change legend; flow diagram only when behavior flow changed; one rejected alternative. | improves — All thirteen aspects, marked ⬆ improves / ➖ unchanged / ⬇ regresses; justify only movement, citing evidence where the repository and scope allow. | verify — Product: numbered steps. Library: Consumer scenario/Call or import/Expected, plus published artifact command. Process: Behavior changed/Lane or verb run/Refuses on/Passes on. Every kind adds one Criterion/Coverage/Evidence row per AC id of each closing issue (HR-11; judged by nen pr converge). content: an empty heading fails body-check through the derived verify-content requirement. | evidence — UZF-26 state/variant evidence table; only where project.evidence.globs is declared. | compat — Symbol/Before/After/Consumer action; semver verdict. | across — What another repository does differently after this merge; recorded rulings. | release-unit — Artifact/Size/Provenance; CON-22 fan-out. | rollout — Target/Flag/Rollback step. | economics — Leorio summary, then the full report in details; no new level-2 headings inside it. | spec — One row per F<nnn>-SC-### the closing spec-derived issue carries, satisfied with a test id or deferred with a reason and a follow-up (docs/config/spec-repo.md, The PR Spec section). Admitted by the run fact spec; rows is nen's spec-rows requirement quoted whole (zheref/nen#493, src/spec/coverage.ts), and nen spec coverage's delivery form proves every criterion is accounted for. | decisions — Every pre-answered row and every default the run took for the maintainer; mandatory on every PR whose run took one, idle (HR-334) or attended (HA#474 AC-1), whatever the kind or family. Any positive source includes it: --decisions, --idle, or --decisions-from a nen.run manifest with a non-empty idleAnswers. A manifest proves only launch pre-answers: a null or empty idleAnswers adds nothing beside --decisions or --idle (the flag wins) and refuses alone; a malformed manifest refuses whatever else is passed. A default taken mid-run or attended is --decisions. | hanten — Exact adopted-gate heading and settled Hanten findings. Each deferred row cites a tracked issue. | prose — HA#503, HR-369: the four PRS rows (criteria, measurable, scope, markers) Chrollo answers on a canon-prose PR, each with a yes or no verdict and the line he read (line N or path:N), never the author. Admitted by the run fact canon-prose (--canon-prose, or --scopes-from a nen review scopes document in which Chrollo's scope claims a changed .md; the architecture globs in nen/workflow.json are canon prose's one definition); rows requires exactly one answered row per letter under the heading. A no is also a Hanten finding with rule PRS-<letter>, medium and pushable. docs/PR-SECTIONS.md section The prose checklist. | checklist — Compact evidence-backed completion conditions, including the checked Hanten-settled evidence line. | issues — Canonical issue URL/scope/merging verdict table and closing lines; Development guard applies. | attribution — Final heading; exact participant ledger from docs/AGENT-ATTRIBUTION.md.
